|errata_history=[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998): entry “Blast The Door, Kid! — If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force to exclude from that battle all characters of ability > 2 and all leaders (on both sides).” Its preface makes revised text the correct gameplay text for all versions of a card; the entry is not labelled “Errata”. Decipher had already printed these words on the white-border [[Blast The Door, Kid! (Revised)]] (Revised A New Hope, September 1998). The [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (29 January 2002) repeats the text and adds: “Characters of ability > 2 or leaders introduced to the battle after this Interrupt has been played are also immediately excluded from the battle.” Print: “After a battle at an interior site is initiated, use 1 Force to cause all leaders and all characters with ability > 2 (on both sides) to be completely excluded from that battle.” See [[Blast The Door, Kid! (Errata)]]. Players Committee: the PC's [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Players Committee ''Decipher Errata'' sheet] (“Official text as of January 1, 2013”; Internet Archive copy of 9 August 2016) still printed the Decipher wording; the next sheet found, [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Players Committee ''Decipher Errata'' sheet] (“Official text as of March 1, 2017”; PDF created 31 May 2017; Internet Archive copy of 5 July 2017), prints “If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force; for remainder of battle, all characters of ability > 2 and all leaders (on both sides) are simultaneously excluded from that battle.” The exact date of the PC change is not known (between those two sheets). The [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|2023 Advanced Rulebook]] Appendix A, the Holotable face and GEMP print the same words without the comma after “battle”. See [[Blast The Door, Kid! (PC Errata)]].
